how: cairn-node 0.4.4 cmd_start -> new_session, unchanged, inside a throwaway container from the cairn-dev:0.1 image (Debian bookworm, tmux 3.3a, Python 3.11.2), with watch_start replaced by a recorder that ran the watch's own capture, `tmux -L cairn capture-pane -p -t =demo: -S -60`, every 0.1-0.5 s. The pane is tmux's default 80x24 for a detached session. Lines are as captured; the token check's `sk-ant-` redaction was applied.
note: A resumed start (claude --resume) with a made-up token. Real render by Claude Code; the history is not real: the transcript holds the failed start of case b, then an earlier resume and a lead reply quoting the login messages, appended by hand. History and the new prompt echo appear in the same first frame. At 0.7 s the spinner runs and nothing after the echo is a failure, yet 0.4.4 killed the lead here: #35. The real failure follows the newest echo at 3.2 s.
